en.title: Word order in questions and negatives
en.summary: Questions and negatives use an auxiliary and change the usual order.

paragraphs: Questions and negatives change the usual word order by using an auxiliary verb.
In a question the auxiliary comes before the subject, and the main verb stays in the base form. In a negative, not follows the auxiliary. A question word comes first.
